title: Ec y thie as marish y lught-thie
description: Ten short, simple stories about home, family and everyday life on the Isle of Man.

lessons.title: Thie Juan
lessons.summary: Juan has a small house and Mona a big one; both are good.
lessons.text:
Shoh Juan. Ta thie ec Juan. Ta'n thie ec Juan beg, agh t'eh mie.

Shoh Mona. Ta thie ec Mona. Ta'n thie ec Mona mooar, as t'eh mie.

Ta Juan ayns y thie beg. Ta Mona ayns y thie mooar.

“Vel y thie mie, Juan?” Ta Mona ayns y thie ec Juan.

“Ta,” ta Juan gra. “Ta'n thie beg, agh t'eh mie. As y thie mooar?”

“Ta'n thie mooar mie,” ta Mona gra. “Cha nel eh beg, agh t'eh mie.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel thie ec Juan?
Ta. Ta thie beg ec Juan.
Vel y thie ec Mona beg?
Cha nel. Ta'n thie ec Mona mooar.
Vel y thie ec Juan mie?
Ta. Ta'n thie beg, agh t'eh mie.
Vel y thie mooar mie?
Ta. Ta'n thie mooar mie.

lessons.title: Ben noa 'sy valley
lessons.summary: A new woman, Breesha, comes to live in the village next to old Illiam.
lessons.text:
Ta ben noa cummal 'sy valley. She Breesha yn ennym eck. Ta Breesha cummal ayns thie noa. Ta'n thie noa mooar.

Ta fer cummal 'sy thie elley. She Illiam yn ennym echey. Ta Illiam shenn, as ta e hie shenn. Ta thie Illiam beg as shenn, agh t'eh mie.

“Shoh yn balley,” ta Illiam gra. “Ta'n balley beg, agh t'eh mie.”

“Ta'n balley mie,” ta Breesha gra. “As ta'n thie noa mie.”

She ben vie ee, as she fer mie eh. Ta'n ven noa cummal 'sy thie noa, as ta'n fer shenn cummal 'sy thie elley. Ta Breesha as Illiam cummal 'sy valley.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Breesha cummal 'sy valley?
Ta. T'ee cummal 'sy valley ayns thie noa.
Vel y thie noa mooar?
Ta. Ta'n thie noa mooar.
Vel Illiam shenn?
Ta. Ta Illiam shenn, as ta e hie shenn.
Vel y balley mooar?
Cha nel. Ta'n balley beg, agh t'eh mie.

lessons.title: Laa cadjin
lessons.summary: On an ordinary day Illiam and Fenella go out to work and come home in the evening.
lessons.text:
She laa cadjin eh. Ta Illiam goll dys yn obbyr. Ta'n obbyr echey ayns y valley mooar. Ta Illiam goll magh veih'n thie.

Ta Fenella goll magh neesht. Ta'n obbyr eck ayns y valley beg.

Tra ta Illiam çheet veih'n obbyr, ta Fenella çheet stiagh 'sy thie. Ta Illiam er çheet stiagh, as ta Fenella er çheet stiagh.

“Va'n obbyr mie?” ta Fenella gra.

“Va,” ta Illiam gra. “Va'n obbyr cadjin, agh va'n obbyr mie. As yn obbyr ayd?”

“Va'n laa cadjin,” ta Fenella gra. “Tra va mee ec yn obbyr, va mee goll magh as çheet stiagh.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Illiam goll dys yn obbyr?
Ta. Ta Illiam goll dys yn obbyr 'sy valley mooar.
Vel yn obbyr ec Fenella 'sy valley mooar?
Cha nel. Ta'n obbyr eck 'sy valley beg.
Row'n obbyr ec Illiam mie?
Va. Va'n obbyr cadjin, agh va'n obbyr mie.

lessons.title: Yn ellan
lessons.summary: Orry lives in the south of an island; a road links its two towns and he drives north.
lessons.text:
Ta Orry cummal er ellan. Ta daa valley er yn ellan: balley ayns y jiass, as balley ayns y twoaie.

Ta thie Orry 'sy valley ayns y jiass. Ta'n thie liorish y raad, ec bun y raad. Ta'n thie beg.

Ayns mean yn ellan, ta thie ard. She thie shenn eh.

Ta raad mooar er yn ellan. Ta'n raad goll veih'n jiass dys y twoaie, as ta ny daa valley er y raad.

Ta Orry goll er y raad dys y twoaie. Ta Orry goll liorish y thie ard ayns mean yn ellan. Ta'n balley ayns y twoaie mooar, as ta ny thieyn ard.

Feyshtyn:
Vel daa valley er yn ellan?
Ta. Ta balley ayns y jiass, as balley ayns y twoaie.
Vel thie Orry liorish y raad?
Ta. Ta'n thie ec bun y raad.
Vel y thie ard ayns y jiass?
Cha nel. Ta'n thie ard ayns mean yn ellan.
Vel ny thieyn ard ayns y twoaie?
Ta. Ta ny thieyn ard 'sy valley ayns y twoaie.

lessons.title: Cloie 'sy tourey
lessons.summary: In summer Aalish and Ean play by the house, and their mother makes them a big dinner.
lessons.text:
She yn tourey eh. Ta Aalish as Ean cloie liorish y thie. Ta Aalish cloie lesh Ean, as ta Ean cloie lesh Aalish.

Ta ad cloie 'sy tourey. Ta'n tourey mie son cloie, as t'eh mie da ny paitçhyn.

“Vel oo cloie, Ean?” ta Aalish gra.

“Ta,” ta Ean gra. “As vel oo hene cloie?”

Ta nyn moir ayns y thie. Ren ee jinnair mooar son ny paitçhyn. Ren ee eh hene. Ta'n jinnair mie da Aalish as da Ean.

“Shoh jinnair mie,” ta Ean gra. “Ta nyn dhie mie 'sy tourey.”

Ren ad cloie 'sy tourey as ren ad goll stiagh 'sy thie.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Aalish cloie lesh Ean?
Ta. Ta Aalish cloie lesh Ean liorish y thie.
Vel y tourey mie son cloie?
Ta. Ta'n tourey mie son cloie.
Ren nyn moir jinnair?
Ren. Ren ee jinnair mooar son ny paitçhyn.

lessons.title: Yn chied vlein
lessons.summary: Ealish starts a new job; by the end of her first year it is going well.
lessons.text:
Ta Ealish goaill toshiaght ec obbyr noa. She yn chied laa jeh'n obbyr noa. Ta Ealish goll dys y balley mooar son y chied cheayrt.

Ec y toshiaght, cha nel yn obbyr mie. Ta'n obbyr noa as mooar. Agh ta Ealish goaill toshiaght dy mie.

Ta mac ec Ealish. She Ean yn ennym echey. T'eh daa vlein d'eash.

Ta Ealish geddyn obbyr share. Ta'n obbyr goll dy mie. Ta Ealish goll dys y balley mooar keayrt elley, as keayrt elley.

Ec jerrey ny bleeaney, ta Ealish geddyn obbyr vooar. She yn chied vlein jeh'n obbyr eck. Ta Ean three bleeaney d'eash nish.

“Va'n chied vlein mie,” ta Ealish gra. “Ta'n jerrey mie.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Ealish goaill toshiaght ec obbyr noa?
Ta. Ta Ealish goaill toshiaght ec obbyr noa.
Row'n obbyr mie ec y toshiaght?
Cha row. Cha row yn obbyr mie ec y toshiaght.
Vel mac ec Ealish?
Ta. T'eh daa vlein d'eash.
Row'n chied vlein mie?
Va. Va'n chied vlein mie.

lessons.title: Çhengey noa
lessons.summary: Pherick from another country has lived on the island for a year and is learning Manx from Moirrey.
lessons.text:
Ta Pherick çheet ass çheer elley. Ta Pherick cummal 'syn ellan rish blein.

Ta enney ec Pherick er daa çhengey. Agh ayns y çheer shoh, ta çhengey elley: yn Ghaelg. Ta'n çhengey shoh noa da Pherick.

Ta Moirrey cummal 'syn ellan. Ta enney eck er y Ghaelg. Ta Pherick goll dys thie Moirrey, as ta Moirrey goll dys thie Pherick.

“Ta'n Ghaelg mie, myr çhengey elley,” ta Moirrey gra rish Pherick. “Foddee oo goaill toshiaght.”

Rish blein, ta Pherick goll dys thie Moirrey. Ec jerrey ny bleeaney, ta enney ec Pherick er y Ghaelg. Foddee eh gra “moghrey mie”, myr Moirrey. Foddee eh goll ass y thie as gra “oie vie”.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Pherick çheet ass çheer elley?
Ta. Ta Pherick çheet ass çheer elley.
Vel enney ec Pherick er daa çhengey?
Ta. Ta enney echey er daa çhengey.
Vel Moirrey cummal 'syn ellan?
Ta. T'ee cummal 'syn ellan.
Vel enney ec Pherick er y Ghaelg nish?
Ta. Foddee eh gra “moghrey mie”, myr Moirrey.

lessons.title: Ny deiney noa
lessons.summary: New neighbours come to the village; old Juan shares his food with them.
lessons.text:
Haink deiney noa dys y balley. Haink ad veih'n balley mooar. Hooar ad thie liorish thie Juan.

Ta Juan shenn. Ta cooid mooar dy vee ayns y thie echey.

“Shoh cooid dy vee,” ta Juan gra rish ny deiney noa. Hug Juan cooid jeh'n vee da ny deiney noa. Hug eh cooid da Catreeney, chammah's da Jamys.

“Ta shen mie,” ta Catreeney gra. “Hooar shin bee mie.”

Ta thie Juan ny smoo na'n thie ec ny deiney noa. Agh hig ny deiney noa dys thie Juan, as hig Juan dys y thie oc.

Shen myr ta'n balley: ta ny deiney cur as geddyn. Hooar Juan deiney mie, chammah's Catreeney as Jamys.

Feyshtyn:
Haink deiney noa dys y balley?
Haink. Haink deiney noa veih'n balley mooar.
Hug Juan cooid jeh'n vee da ny deiney noa?
Hug. Hug eh cooid da Catreeney, chammah's da Jamys.
Vel thie Juan ny smoo na'n thie ec ny deiney noa?
Ta. Ta thie Juan ny smoo.

lessons.title: Yn thie shenn
lessons.summary: Ffinlo buys an old house from the state and finds an old book under it that helps him mend it.
lessons.text:
Hooar Ffinlo thie shenn veih'n steat. Va'n thie ec y steat, agh nish ta'n thie ec Ffinlo. Ta Ffinlo jannoo obbyr er y thie.

Ta cummey mie er y thie, agh cha nel y thie mie. Ta Ffinlo jannoo y thie noa.

Fo'n thie, hooar Ffinlo shenn lioar. Ta imraa 'sy lioar er y thie, as er cummaltee y thie. Va daa chummaltagh 'sy thie: ben as fer.

Ta Ffinlo jannoo ymmyd jeh'n lioar. Ta'n thie noa jeh'n chummey shenn. Ta Ffinlo jannoo ymmyd jeh'n lioar son yn obbyr.

“Shoh yn thie shenn,” ta Ffinlo gra. “Agh she thie noa eh nish.”

Feyshtyn:
Hooar Ffinlo y thie veih'n steat?
Hooar. Hooar eh y thie veih'n steat.
Hooar Ffinlo shenn lioar fo'n thie?
Hooar. Hooar eh shenn lioar fo'n thie.
Vel imraa 'sy lioar er cummaltee y thie?
Ta. Va daa chummaltagh 'sy thie: ben as fer.
Vel Ffinlo jannoo ymmyd jeh'n lioar?
Ta. T'eh jannoo ymmyd jeh'n lioar son yn obbyr.

lessons.title: Eddyr daa valley
lessons.summary: Voirrey's grandfather dies; she and her brother share his house between two villages.
lessons.text:
Ta Voirrey cummal ayns Nerin, ayns coontae beg 'sy jiass. Ta daa valley 'sy choontae. Ta raad eddyr ny daa valley, as ta'n raad kiangley ny daa valley.

Va shenn ayr Voirrey cummal ayns thie eddyr ny daa valley. Hooar eh baase 'sy tourey, as eh shenn.

Rere y shenn ayr, va'n thie son Voirrey as son Ean. She Ean braar Voirrey.

Ren Voirrey as Ean y thie y rheynn. Ren ad rheynn y thie: ta Voirrey cummal ayns y cooid noa, as ta Ean cummal ayns y cooid shenn.

“Rere Ean, she thie mie eh,” ta Voirrey gra. “As rere mish, she thie mie eh neesht.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Voirrey cummal ayns coontae beg?
Ta. T'ee cummal ayns coontae beg 'sy jiass.
Vel y raad kiangley ny daa valley?
Ta. Ta'n raad kiangley ny daa valley.
Hooar y shenn ayr baase?
Hooar. Hooar eh baase 'sy tourey.
Ren Voirrey as Ean y thie y rheynn?
Ren. Ta Voirrey cummal ayns y cooid noa, as Ean ayns y cooid shenn.
